fieldValues.statement: Every write can be seen before it happens over acting at once
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless the command is the scheduled run of a write a person already reviewed in its dry-run form.
fieldValues.context: Every write command is dry by default with one --apply flag, and prints what it would do. Enforces 926c059f rule 7. Evidence: five different write verbs today, and a dry-run dispatch that still posted the desk (clerk#93).
